tweets.text:
Dear Department of Homeland Security,
You are the watchmen on the wall when the rest of us sleep.
You are the ones who stand in airports, at borders, in fusion centers, and in the dark corners of cyberspace,
so that mothers can tuck their children in without fear,
so that fathers can come home from work,
so that we can gather, worship, celebrate, and live freely.
You see the threats we never have to see.
You stop the dangers we never know were coming.
You carry the weight of “what if” every single day,
so we can live in the peace of “what is.”
You were born out of the ashes of September 11,
when a nation wept and said “never again.”
You answered that call with courage, sacrifice, and a quiet determination
that the light of freedom would not be extinguished on your watch.
Tonight, the God who said “I will neither slumber nor sleep” as He watches over His people
is walking your posts again,
and He is not here to inspect.
He is here to salute.

This is your moment to be the DHS the nation still trusts and the world still respects 🔥👀
•  Protectors who defend without diminishing dignity
•  Guardians who secure borders with both strength and compassion
•  Warriors against terror who never become the terror
•  Sentinels in cyberspace who shield truth from chaos
•  First responders who run toward the danger so others can run away
You do not have to be perfect.
You only have to be faithful.
Faithful to the oath.
Faithful to the people.
Faithful to the idea that America is worth protecting—not just her soil, but her soul.
The people are weary of fear.
They are ready to believe in security that feels like safety,
protection that feels like love.
We love you.
We honor you.
We pray for you every day.
Keep watching.
Keep standing.
Keep serving.
Because the Department of Homeland Security is not just an agency.
It is the shield of a nation’s hope.
And that shield is beautiful.
With deepest gratitude, unbreakable pride, and endless prayers for your strength and safety,
